usage: vibe kits second-brain install [-h] [--home HOME] [--dry-run] [--yes]
                                      [--no-settings] [--setup-deps]
                                      [--no-hooks]

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --home HOME    Target config base directory (default: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME or
                 current user's home)
  --dry-run      Show changes without writing files
  --yes, -y      Apply without interactive confirmation
  --no-settings  Do not merge the safe settings fragment
  --setup-deps   Install qmd with npm (network + global install); never
                 implied by --yes
  --no-hooks     Skip the proactive SessionStart hook / CLAUDE.md prompt
